answers.rationale: Kara has accepted a connected conference/venue hotel with an explicit refrigerator request when its location materially reduces operational risk, while treating appliance status as something to verify rather than assume. Here the attached indoor walkway, 7:30 starts, no-car plan, full recovery amenities, and negligible rate difference justify a cancellable Tower hold; the note correctly preserves the lead while requiring coffee-maker and mini-fridge confirmation before final commitment.

For conference trips with early in-building obligations, Kara has sometimes prioritized the connected hotel despite a refrigerator being request-only when that proximity reduces presenter and materials friction. The Tower's same-building Friday registration and 8:00 lab access, along with its pool/hot-tub recovery setup, make it the proper lead while reservations verifies the two in-room basics rather than treating the website omission as proof they are absent.

Kara repeatedly chooses the better-rated, confirmed-room-setup hotel over a nearby medical property when the latter cannot actually guarantee a refrigerator, even for early clinical starts. Unlike a website omission that can be checked promptly, Medical Center Block has already said its mini-fridge cannot be guaranteed until assignment. Five Points preserves the required coffee/fridge routine at a manageable 7-10 minute drive and avoids making a must-have amenity contingent on luck; the lost hot tub is a secondary trade-off.
